scope: 500 live + 63 delisted small-caps, 150 weekly dates, 2023-05 ~ 2026-05 (~3y), 36,454 observations
headline: Surge OCCURRENCE is robustly predictable (3.5x lift, monotonic, survivorship-corrected). Net trading profit is real but fragile: ~+1%/trade on the top decile only, and only with vol-appropriate wide/ATR exits + controlled slippage. Outside the top decile it is breakeven-to-negative.

net_trade_by_exit.desc: realistic net: entry T+1 open, target/stop/timeout exit, 100bps round-trip slippage, top-10 by score

survivorship_check.desc: delisted names drag returns -> naive (survivor-only) backtest was optimistic

attention_forwardtest.desc: Does an attention re-rank beat raw pre_score? proxy = RVOL (look-ahead-safe). 2,996 pool-obs / 150 dates. News/Claude attention NOT testable (FMP historical news 402-gated; LLM hindsight contamination).
attention_forwardtest.finding: High attention (RVOL) predicts MORE surges but WORSE net return (inverse). Chasing volume = chasing already-noticed names = higher reversal risk. Coiled (low-RVOL, not-yet-noticed) names earn the most. => Use the AI layer to DEMOTE late/exhausted names (fade-filter), NOT to chase high-attention ones.

caveats: Survivorship only PARTIALLY corrected — FMP delisted-companies surfaces mostly recent (2026) delistings; 2022-25 delistings under-covered.
fuel (short float) and catalyst (analyst) overlays NOT historically validated; only the OHLCV signal (readiness+explosiveness) is backtested.
Single regime (2023-2026, mostly bullish/high-dispersion). No bear-market stress test.
Entry at T+1 open and same-bar target/stop are approximations; real fills differ.
Claude rising/fading narrative is a LIVE-only hypothesis — not forward-tested (hindsight + no historical news).
